---
title: "Task 2: Quality control, differential gene expression (DESeq2) and FCS (Week 5)"
format: html
---

Library loading
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
```

Paths are relative to this file (the `R/` folder).
```{r}
data_dir    <- "../data/"
results_dir <- "../results"
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
alpha <- 0.05
```

## Load data

Gene counts and metadata. GSE167529 uses the 25 mM glucose samples only (21 samples, one per donor); the full 42-sample metadata is only used to show the glucose design. Age (age at donation, Table 2 of PMC8636510) is already in the GSE167529 metadata. GSE90514 has no age information. Note: donor FOX-073-001 is male in the GEO metadata but female in Table 2 of the paper; the GEO value is used here.
```{r}
gene_90514       <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE90514_gene_counts.rds"))
meta_90514       <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE90514_meta.rds"))

gene_167529_25mM <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE167529_25mM_gene_counts.rds"))
meta_167529_25mM <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE167529_25mM_meta.rds"))
meta_167529      <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE167529_all42_meta.rds"))
```

Convert the design variables to factors, and check that the sample order is the same in the counts and the metadata (Week 5).
```{r}
meta_90514$condition <- factor(meta_90514$condition, levels = c("Control", "PD"))
meta_90514$gender    <- factor(meta_90514$gender)

meta_167529_25mM$condition <- factor(meta_167529_25mM$condition, levels = c("Control", "PD"))
meta_167529_25mM[c("gender", "batch", "run", "age_group")] <-
  lapply(meta_167529_25mM[c("gender", "batch", "run", "age_group")], factor)

all(rownames(meta_90514) == colnames(gene_90514))               # must be TRUE
all(rownames(meta_167529_25mM) == colnames(gene_167529_25mM))   # must be TRUE
```

## Design balance and confounder checks

GSE90514: condition x gender.
```{r}
table(meta_90514$condition, meta_90514$gender)
```

GSE167529, all 42 samples: glucose x condition / batch / sequencing run.
```{r}
table(meta_167529$glucose, meta_167529$condition)
table(meta_167529$glucose, meta_167529$batch)
table(meta_167529$glucose, meta_167529$run)
```

GSE167529, 25 mM only: is any confounder unbalanced between PD and Control?
```{r}
table(meta_167529_25mM$condition, meta_167529_25mM$gender)
table(meta_167529_25mM$condition, meta_167529_25mM$batch)
table(meta_167529_25mM$condition, meta_167529_25mM$run)
table(meta_167529_25mM$condition, meta_167529_25mM$age_group)
tapply(meta_167529_25mM$age, meta_167529_25mM$condition, summary)
```

## Library sizes

Total read counts per sample, in millions.
```{r}
round(colSums(gene_90514) / 1e6, 2)
summary(round(colSums(gene_167529_25mM) / 1e6, 2))
```

## Low-count filtering

Keep genes with at least 10 reads in at least as many samples as the smallest group has (4 for GSE90514, 9 for GSE167529). This is the same filter as in the DIU analysis (task 3).
```{r}
gene_90514_filt  <- round(gene_90514[rowSums(gene_90514 >= 10) >= 4, ])
gene_167529_filt <- round(gene_167529_25mM[rowSums(gene_167529_25mM >= 10) >= 9, ])

nrow(gene_90514_filt)
nrow(gene_167529_filt)
```

## Gene sets and gene names

GO:BP gene sets (Week 5). If msigdbr gives the error "unused argument collection", the server has an older msigdbr version: then use `category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP"`. The same table is used to add gene symbols to the result tables.
```{r}
BP_df   <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP")
BP_list <- split(BP_df$ensembl_gene, BP_df$gs_name)

id_map  <- BP_df %>% distinct(ensembl_gene, gene_symbol) %>% filter(!duplicated(ensembl_gene))
ens2sym <- setNames(id_map$gene_symbol, id_map$ensembl_gene)
```

Helper to turn a DESeq2 result into a table with gene IDs (Ensembl version removed) and symbols.
```{r}
res_to_df <- function(res) {
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  df$gene_id <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(df))
  df$symbol  <- unname(ens2sym[df$gene_id])
  df
}
```

## Dataset 1: PRKN (GSE90514)

### PCA quality check (Week 5: rlog + plotPCA)
```{r}
dds_pca_90514 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(gene_90514),
                                        colData   = meta_90514,
                                        design    = ~ condition)
rld_90514 <- rlog(dds_pca_90514)

p1_90514 <- plotPCA(rld_90514, intgroup = c("condition")) +
  ggtitle("GSE90514 PCA: condition")
p2_90514 <- plotPCA(rld_90514, intgroup = c("condition", "gender")) +
  ggtitle("GSE90514 PCA: condition + gender")

p1_90514
p2_90514
```

### DESeq2 without and with gender (Week 5)
```{r}
dds_90514 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = gene_90514_filt,
                                    colData   = meta_90514,
                                    design    = ~ condition)
dds_90514 <- DESeq(dds_90514)
res_90514 <- res_to_df(results(dds_90514, contrast = c("condition", "PD", "Control")))

dds_90514_gender <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = gene_90514_filt,
                                           colData   = meta_90514,
                                           design    = ~ gender + condition)
dds_90514_gender <- DESeq(dds_90514_gender)
res_90514_gender <- res_to_df(results(dds_90514_gender, contrast = c("condition", "PD", "Control")))
```

How many genes are significant, and how many are found by both models?
```{r}
signif_90514        <- res_90514$gene_id[!is.na(res_90514$padj) & res_90514$padj < alpha]
signif_90514_gender <- res_90514_gender$gene_id[!is.na(res_90514_gender$padj) & res_90514_gender$padj < alpha]

length(signif_90514)
length(signif_90514_gender)
length(intersect(signif_90514, signif_90514_gender))
```

## Dataset 2: LRRK2 / sporadic PD (GSE167529, 25 mM)

### PCA quality check (Week 5: rlog + plotPCA)
```{r}
dds_pca_167529 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(gene_167529_25mM),
                                         colData   = meta_167529_25mM,
                                         design    = ~ condition)
rld_167529 <- rlog(dds_pca_167529)

p1_167529 <- plotPCA(rld_167529, intgroup = c("condition")) +
  ggtitle("GSE167529 (25 mM) PCA: condition")
p2_167529 <- plotPCA(rld_167529, intgroup = c("condition", "gender")) +
  ggtitle("GSE167529 (25 mM) PCA: condition + gender")
p3_167529 <- plotPCA(rld_167529, intgroup = c("condition", "batch")) +
  ggtitle("GSE167529 (25 mM) PCA: condition + batch")
p4_167529 <- plotPCA(rld_167529, intgroup = c("condition", "run")) +
  ggtitle("GSE167529 (25 mM) PCA: condition + sequencing run")
p5_167529 <- plotPCA(rld_167529, intgroup = c("condition", "age_group")) +
  ggtitle("GSE167529 (25 mM) PCA: condition + age group")

p1_167529
p2_167529
p3_167529
p4_167529
p5_167529
```

### DESeq2 without and with batch + gender + age (Week 5)
```{r}
dds_167529 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = gene_167529_filt,
                                     colData   = meta_167529_25mM,
                                     design    = ~ condition)
dds_167529 <- DESeq(dds_167529)
res_167529 <- res_to_df(results(dds_167529, contrast = c("condition", "PD", "Control")))

dds_167529_adj <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = gene_167529_filt,
                                         colData   = meta_167529_25mM,
                                         design    = ~ batch + gender + age_scaled + condition)
dds_167529_adj <- DESeq(dds_167529_adj)
res_167529_adj <- res_to_df(results(dds_167529_adj, contrast = c("condition", "PD", "Control")))
```

How many genes are significant, and how many are found by both models?
```{r}
signif_167529     <- res_167529$gene_id[!is.na(res_167529$padj) & res_167529$padj < alpha]
signif_167529_adj <- res_167529_adj$gene_id[!is.na(res_167529_adj$padj) & res_167529_adj$padj < alpha]

length(signif_167529)
length(signif_167529_adj)
length(intersect(signif_167529, signif_167529_adj))
```

## Summary of differentially expressed genes

The adjusted models are used from here on.
```{r}
summarize_deg <- function(df, label) {
  sig <- !is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < alpha
  tibble(Model = label,
         DEGs  = sum(sig),
         Up    = sum(sig & df$log2FoldChange > 0),
         Down  = sum(sig & df$log2FoldChange < 0),
         DEGs_absLFC1 = sum(sig & abs(df$log2FoldChange) > 1))
}

deg_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarize_deg(res_90514,        "GSE90514 ~ condition"),
  summarize_deg(res_90514_gender, "GSE90514 ~ gender + condition"),
  summarize_deg(res_167529,       "GSE167529 ~ condition"),
  summarize_deg(res_167529_adj,   "GSE167529 ~ batch + gender + age + condition")
)
deg_summary
```

Top 10 genes per dataset.
```{r}
res_90514_gender %>% arrange(padj) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, symbol, baseMean, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj) %>% head(10)

res_167529_adj %>% arrange(padj) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, symbol, baseMean, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj) %>% head(10)
```

Genes significant in both datasets.
```{r}
overlap_ids <- intersect(signif_90514_gender, signif_167529_adj)
length(overlap_ids)

inner_join(
  res_90514_gender %>% filter(gene_id %in% overlap_ids) %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, symbol, log2FC_GSE90514 = log2FoldChange, padj_GSE90514 = padj),
  res_167529_adj   %>% filter(gene_id %in% overlap_ids) %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, log2FC_GSE167529 = log2FoldChange, padj_GSE167529 = padj),
  by = "gene_id")
```

Volcano plots.
```{r}
make_volcano <- function(df, title_txt) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    mutate(sig = case_when(padj < alpha & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1 ~ "padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1",
                           padj < alpha ~ "padj < 0.05",
                           TRUE ~ "NS")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pvalue), color = sig)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1" = "#D55E00",
                                  "padj < 0.05" = "#0072B2", "NS" = "grey70")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    labs(x = "log2 fold change (PD vs Control)", y = "-log10(p-value)",
         color = "Significance", title = title_txt) +
    theme_bw()
}

v_90514  <- make_volcano(res_90514_gender, "GSE90514 (~ gender + condition)")
v_167529 <- make_volcano(res_167529_adj,   "GSE167529 25 mM (~ batch + gender + age + condition)")
v_90514
v_167529
```

## FCS with fgsea (Week 5)

Genes ranked by the DESeq2 `stat` value: positive = higher in PD, negative = higher in Control.
```{r}
make_stats <- function(df) {
  myStats <- setNames(df$stat, df$gene_id)
  myStats <- myStats[!is.na(myStats)]
  sort(myStats, decreasing = TRUE)
}

stats_90514  <- make_stats(res_90514_gender)
stats_167529 <- make_stats(res_167529_adj)

set.seed(42)   # fgseaMultilevel uses random sampling
fg_90514  <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = BP_list, stats = stats_90514,
                             minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, scoreType = "std")
fg_167529 <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = BP_list, stats = stats_167529,
                             minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, scoreType = "std")
```

Number of significant gene sets and the top 10 per dataset.
```{r}
fg_sig_90514  <- fg_90514  %>% arrange(padj) %>% filter(padj < alpha)
fg_sig_167529 <- fg_167529 %>% arrange(padj) %>% filter(padj < alpha)

nrow(fg_sig_90514)
nrow(fg_sig_167529)

fg_sig_90514  %>% dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj, size) %>% head(10)
fg_sig_167529 %>% dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj, size) %>% head(10)
```

Top gene set: enrichment plot and the first 3 leading-edge genes (Week 5).
```{r}
if (nrow(fg_sig_90514) > 0) {
  print(plotEnrichment(BP_list[[fg_sig_90514$pathway[1]]], stats_90514) +
          labs(title = paste0("GSE90514: ", fg_sig_90514$pathway[1])))
  print(ens2sym[head(fg_sig_90514$leadingEdge[[1]], 3)])
}

if (nrow(fg_sig_167529) > 0) {
  print(plotEnrichment(BP_list[[fg_sig_167529$pathway[1]]], stats_167529) +
          labs(title = paste0("GSE167529: ", fg_sig_167529$pathway[1])))
  print(ens2sym[head(fg_sig_167529$leadingEdge[[1]], 3)])
}
```

## Comparison of the two datasets at gene-set level

Gene sets significant in both datasets, and the Spearman correlation of NES.
```{r}
bp_comp <- inner_join(
  fg_90514  %>% transmute(pathway, NES_GSE90514 = NES,  padj_GSE90514 = padj),
  fg_167529 %>% transmute(pathway, NES_GSE167529 = NES, padj_GSE167529 = padj),
  by = "pathway") %>%
  arrange(pmin(padj_GSE90514, padj_GSE167529))

sum(bp_comp$padj_GSE90514 < alpha & bp_comp$padj_GSE167529 < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
cor(bp_comp$NES_GSE90514, bp_comp$NES_GSE167529, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
```

Top 15 gene sets in both datasets.
```{r}
top_names <- head(bp_comp$pathway, 15)

bp_plot_df <- bind_rows(
  fg_90514  %>% transmute(pathway, NES, padj, Dataset = "GSE90514"),
  fg_167529 %>% transmute(pathway, NES, padj, Dataset = "GSE167529 (25 mM)")) %>%
  filter(pathway %in% top_names) %>%
  mutate(pathway = gsub("^GOBP_", "", pathway),
         sig = ifelse(padj < alpha, "FDR < 0.05", "FDR >= 0.05"))

p_bp <- ggplot(bp_plot_df, aes(x = Dataset, y = reorder(pathway, NES),
                               color = NES, size = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FDR < 0.05" = 16, "FDR >= 0.05" = 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", size = "-log10(FDR)", shape = "Significance",
       title = "GO:BP FCS comparison (PD vs Control)") +
  theme_bw()
p_bp
```

save_fg <- function(fg, file) {
  fg <- as.data.frame(fg)
  fg$leadingEdge <- sapply(fg$leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")
  write.csv(fg, file.path(results_dir, file), row.names = FALSE)
}
save_fg(fg_90514,  "04_GSE90514_fcs_go_bp.csv")
save_fg(fg_167529, "04_GSE167529_fcs_go_bp.csv")
write.csv(bp_comp, file.path(results_dir, "04_go_bp_cross_study.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
